mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_enum_data enum_data INNER JOIN om_ai_task task ON task.version_id = enum_data.version_id WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND enum_data.enum_type = #{enumType} AND enum_data.status = 0 AND enum_data.valid_flag = 1 AND enum_data.del_flag = 0 AND (enum_data.enum_value = #{value} OR enum_data.enum_label = #{value})
